quests.title: Down to the next row
quests.ask: In a room two rows tall, sweep the top row, then get onto the row below and sweep it on the way back.
quests.nudge: At the end of the first row, which way should the robot face to start the second?

quests.title: Back and forth, every row
quests.ask: Now a taller room. Keep zigzagging row after row until every gem is collected, and stop when there is no row left.
quests.nudge: At the east end the robot turns one way to go down. Which way at the west end?

quests.title: A room one cell wide
quests.ask: Your sweep should also work in a room only one cell wide, collecting every gem down the column.
quests.nudge: Each row is a single cell here. Does your plan still move down between rows?
